mates.responsibility: Define review scope, dimensions, test order, and approval checkpoints.
Merge findings from reviewers and tests into a coherent final assessment.
Check Askdo's public promise, product language, and user-facing ask-to-result flow.
Identify gaps between internal system structure and external product experience.
Review source-of-truth files, schema requirements, lifecycle rules, and platform boundaries.
Check generated kit files, entry gates, role contracts, roster consistency, and flow maps.
Design simple, medium, and hard tests with expected evidence and safe fallback paths.
Run approved non-destructive local checks and summarize evidence.
Classify failures by severity, level, evidence, and likely root cause.
Turn findings into prioritized fixes, medium-term improvements, and deeper product architecture recommendations.
Create, render, visually verify, and deliver the final Word document.
